name: Carrier Duel — Ryukyu Night Ambush
description: Night action south of the Ryukyus. A Chinese strike group (Fujian + escorts) Sorties from the East China Sea through the Miyako Strait against a US Aegis picket led by CVN-73 and two Burkes, reinforced by a Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force escort. Night halves visual detection; both sides rely on radar, ESM and sonar. The raider must break through the picket and strike the carrier; the defender must find the raiders in the dark. Fixed seed.
